sections.heading: Durgapur: Steel, Chemicals and Power on the Damodar
paragraphs: Durgapur, on the Damodar in Paschim Bardhaman district, was planned as an integrated industrial city and is the biggest industrial hub in West Bengal. The Damodar Valley Corporation's Durgapur Barrage came first; Durgapur Steel Plant followed in 1955 and is now part of SAIL, and Hindustan Steel later added an alloy steel plant. Durgapur Chemicals was set up by the state in 1963 and Durgapur Projects Limited built the city's first thermal power station. Wikipedia counts industrial units in the region rising from 46 in 1951 to 430 in 2019.

Private plants include GE Power India, Philips Carbon Black, Graphite India, Sankey Wheels and Birla Cement. Electropolished pipe is not a process material for any of them. What these plants do buy is certified stainless tube for laboratories, gas analysers, water chemistry and instruments, and a small share of that is worth specifying with an electropolished bore.

sections.heading: Where Durgapur's Plants Use Electropolished Tube
paragraphs: Steel and alloy steel melt shops check every heat on spark spectrometers that run on high-purity argon, and coke ovens and blast furnaces run continuous analysers on process gas. Short runs from the gas source to these instruments benefit from an electropolished 316L bore, which holds less moisture and fewer particles and lets the line purge clean quickly after maintenance.

Thermal power units, including captive plants, run steam and water sampling panels feeding conductivity, silica, sodium and dissolved-oxygen analysers. Seamless 316L to ASTM A269 or A213 suits most of that work; an electropolished bore is worth it mainly on lines to trace-level analysers. For chemical plants, the grade has to be checked against the actual chemical, concentration and temperature before finish is discussed.

sections.heading: The Durgapur State Dairy
paragraphs: Durgapur also has a state dairy, inaugurated in 1972 by the then Chief Minister Siddhartha Shankar Ray, when output was put at about 50,000 litres of milk a day. The state cabinet approved its revival in January 2015, and in 2017 Millennium Post reported Rs 7.65 crore allotted for the work, with Mother Dairy engaging staff under the contract. We have not confirmed its present output.

Any dairy restart or upgrade needs sanitary tube: 304L with an SF1 bore for most milk lines, 316L for hot CIP and brine service, and SF4 electropolished tube for curd, flavoured milk and other cultured or long-life products.

sections.heading: Training Institutes, Hospitals and Laboratory Users
paragraphs: The National Power Training Institute's eastern centre in Durgapur trains plant personnel for the power sector, and the city's hospitals, colleges and plant laboratories buy small lots of high-purity tube for gas and water services. For these buyers we quote small quantities with the same certification as a plant order, so the material can be traced and inspected.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Durgapur RFQ
paragraphs: List each line with its service (spectrometer argon, analyser sample, steam and water sampling, DM water, dairy circuit), the fluid or gas, design pressure and temperature, OD and wall, quantity per size, joining method and any Ra limit. Contractors should add the plant owner's specification and inspection requirements.

We reply with a quotation within 30 minutes. Each order carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number and PMI on every length; electropolished lots also include our internal Ra report. Dispatch and transit to Durgapur are confirmed in writing with each quotation.

sections.heading: Supplying Durgapur and the Asansol–Bardhaman Belt
paragraphs: Kazi Nazrul Islam Airport, India's first private-sector greenfield airport, serves Durgapur. We dispatch from Mumbai and can quote one line list covering several sites in the region.
